Pure Quartz Locations & Farming Guide

Snow-region material needed for Circuit Boards and Pal Metal.

On this page
  • What it's used for
  • Where to find it
  • Best Pals for mining it
  • Farming tips

Pure Quartz is harvested from quartz rocks in snowy and icy terrain. It's the key ingredient for Circuit Boards, which unlock most late-game tech.

What it's used for

Recipe
Circuit Board — Pure Quartz ×4 + Polymer ×2
Pal Metal Ingot — Ore ×4 + Paldium Fragment ×2 + Pure Quartz ×1
Pure Quartz Quarry — unlocks passive production

Where to find it

Look for pure quartz rocks in the snowy regions — the Astral Mountains and the Frostallion area are the main early sources.

Sources

  • Mine pure quartz rocks in snowy/icy terrain
  • Pure Quartz Mine (base building)
  • Drops: Astegon (×3-5, 100%), Frostallion Noct, Neptilius (×10, 100%)
  • Frozen Cave of the Snow Mountain expeditions

Farming tips

  • Bring an Ice-type-friendly team — the quartz areas have strong wild Pals.
  • The Pure Quartz Quarry is worth building before the late-game tech push.
  • Save quartz for Circuit Boards first; Pal Metal Ingots can wait.
